project_type: FastAPI backend with LangGraph agent orchestration, hybrid storage (SQLite + ChromaDB + NetworkX), Python 3.11+
build_system: pip with requirements.txt (already exists with all dependencies: fastapi==0.115.0, langchain==0.3.7, langgraph==0.2.45, chromadb==0.5.15, sentence-transformers==3.2.1, networkx==3.4.1, pandas==2.2.3)
test_framework: Manual testing with scripts/test_queries.py against 18 evaluation queries from docs
build_command: pip install -r requirements.txt (already done in setup step)
verification_instructions: For each feature: (1) Run data ingestion scripts if applicable, (2) Start FastAPI with uvicorn main:app --reload, (3) Test specific tool/endpoint with curl or frontend, (4) Verify data integrity in SQLite/ChromaDB/JSON files
snapshot_or_generated_files: SQLite database data/db/oilwells.db created by ingestion scripts; ChromaDB collections in data/chroma/; NetworkX graph exported to data/graph/knowledge_graph.json; extracted rules in data/rules/rules.json. All generated by scripts, not checked into git.
environment_constraints: Ollama must be running with gemma4:e4b or gemma4:12b model pulled. OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000 required for long SOPs. Windows environment with PowerShell. Backend must run on port 8000, frontend on port 3000. Never modify .env file Ollama settings (OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://localhost:11434, OLLAMA_MODEL=gemma4:e4b) already configured.
contribution_requirements: From README: use local Gemma 4 via Ollama (no API keys), store time-series in SQLite with proper indexing, vector embeddings in ChromaDB, graph data in NetworkX. Memory system must track provenance (who, when, why, scope) for all corrections. Citations required for all agent responses. Agent must use LangGraph for orchestration with 8 specialized tools.
key_patterns: Data files use JSONL for append-only logs (inspections.jsonl, maintenance.jsonl, context.jsonl). Maintenance reports are markdown files with structured sections (Root cause, Compliance check table, Parts and cost table). Well types (T200, T350) have different production thresholds extracted from manuals. Spill response and regulatory compliance SOPs contain deadline rules with protocol IDs (SR-01, SR-02, RC-01, etc.). Production status calculated as: (wellhead_temp_c - ambient_temp_c) >= threshold where T200 threshold=15°C, T350 threshold=20°C.
directory_structure: backend/ contains agent/ (LangGraph orchestration), tools/ (8 specialized tools), memory/ (session & correction tracking), data/ (db/ for SQLite, chroma/ for vector store, graph/ for NetworkX, rules/ for extracted SOP rules, memory/ for JSON conversation logs), scripts/ (data ingestion and testing). sample-data/ contains fleet/ (areas.json, users.json, well-types/*.md, sops/*.md) and assets/ (WELL-XXXX directories with metadata.json, inspections.jsonl, maintenance.jsonl, context.jsonl, maintenance-reports/*.md). Frontend is Next.js 14 in frontend/ directory.
